university_context: Curricula overemphasize standalone big data infrastructure (Hadoop/Spark clusters) while under-indexing on data storytelling and business translation.
Big Data skills show zero independent impact on junior salary hikes (p=0.217, Importance 0.0107, Rank #5); Storytelling is Rank #1 driver.
Replace written exam reports with mandatory oral project defenses where students present findings to simulated non-technical business stakeholders.
Shift 40% of lab time from distributed system configuration to interactive dashboard design (Tableau/PowerBI) and experimental A/B test design.
Eliminate synthetic toy datasets (Iris, Titanic); train students on raw, multi-source enterprise data with missingness and conflicting labels.
100% of graduating data science capstones include an executive summary and interactive dashboard; graduate median placement salary increases by >=25%.
Curricular modernization requires retraining academic faculty on modern BI visualization and consultative communication.
